grh_5a4838f3c7d87bc2bd3f.title: My Son
paragraphs: Bachelor engineer Peter Mallison has barely moved into the old Decatur mansion when his houseboy finds a three-month-old baby abandoned on the doorstep during a storm. A note from the desperate mother identifies the child as little Jim and asks whoever lives in the beautiful house to be good to him; a young woman found collapsed nearby soon dies, apparently leaving the baby alone in the world. Peter initially insists that family life has no place in his plans, yet he becomes deeply attached to the child. When no suitable Rivers End home can be found, arrangements are made to send Jim to an orphanage in Perryville. Peter realizes too late that he cannot let the boy go, races the train by car, reaches Perryville and takes Jim back from the accompanying nurse, declaring the child his son. His next problem is providing a motherly home. Judy declines Peter's proposal that she leave her work to help raise the boy, so she introduces him to Abby Westing, a capable woman who loves children. Abby moves in to care for Jim, and within weeks she and Peter are so obviously falling in love that Christian and Judy expect the new family to end in marriage.

This [[show|dr-christian|Dr. Christian]] broadcast aired on December 6, 1944. It is listed as episode 315 in the archive. [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes Jean Hersholt and Rosemary De Camp. Other credited names include Bob Anderson as announcer.
The surviving recording runs about 24 minutes. The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.b199d95f77b6c241|Vaseline]].

grh_5ae439b3bde38159b315.title: The Highwayman
paragraphs: A romantic outlaw rides by moonlight to meet Bess, the landlord’s daughter, until soldiers seize her and bind her in the window as bait for his return. Unable to escape, Bess reaches the trigger of a musket and shoots herself to warn him as he approaches. grh_5a7e667d948f052a01db.title: Fontaine Harris, Le Baron De Paree
paragraphs: In 1929, small-time con men Fontaine Harris and Vernon abandon a failing high-speed-car racket when talking pictures suggest a richer scam. They recruit a French hotel worker, give him a glamorous screen identity and create a nonexistent motion-picture company that attracts would-be stars and investors in Kansas City. Moving on before the fraud is exposed, they take the operation toward Chicago and become entangled with gangsters who want in on the movie business. The scheme collapses into another escape, but their companion Millie comes away with a fortune in real bootlegging money. Newly flush, the group decides to refund the Kansas City investors and head west to try its luck in Hollywood.

Other credited names include Elliott Lewis as director, Elliott Lewis as producer, Ken Gerard as writer, and Andy Griffith as host.

grh_5ad1d3628a340102e677.title: The Professor Regrets
paragraphs: An old acquaintance tells Harry that a respected professor preparing to leave for an important American post has been meeting secretly with a known Soviet agent. Harry tests the story by posing as the professor's replacement contact, copying the identification signals used during clandestine boat meetings. The professor accepts Harry as a Russian operative and incriminates himself, but Harry has no witnesses and his own reputation makes officials reluctant to believe him. He takes the evidence to the professor's longtime mentor, who has regarded the man almost as a son. Confronted with proof of the betrayal, the older man ultimately shoots the professor and prepares to answer to the police, leaving Harry to reflect on the cost of exposing the traitor.

grh_5aa7de9578c8d9c8a42a.title: The Notorious Canary Trainer
paragraphs: A criminal named Wilson appears to confess to murder and then shoots himself from a pier, while his missing victim and a pair of dead canaries deepen the mystery. Holmes discovers Wilson had planned a fake suicide with blank cartridges so he could disappear after abandoning his old identity. His wife secretly replaced the blanks with live ammunition, killing him for real, and Holmes proves she loaded the gun by matching her fingerprints and secures her confession.
